facts.value: a place outside the walls outside the garden walls

facts.label: Where
facts.value: text: west of 畅春园, north of 西花园 (S02 p.107; 日下 j76:36b 'the 马厂 of 西花园' outside 畅春园's 大西门); today's 西苑操场路 (osm way 173346289) runs through it, C; its extent, a circle of 150 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 日下 j80:7a: the YMY's water 'from 玉泉山 由西馬厰入進水閘'. S02 pp.21-22: by 1934 the drill ground of the troops at 西苑 covered 畅春园 and 西花园, with barracks; 'the headquarters of the Imperial Guard' of late Qing on its north side (post-1860, not for 1860). Also: today's road name 西苑操场路 (osm way 173346289): the 1909 drill ground, C (Western cavalry parade ground and Military Review Tower), 181 m from the point used. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 2015,565, fit rms 95 m (Kiaochang), 369 m from the point used.
